description: Na₂PtC₄H₄Br₂(N₂O)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to four N and two equivalent O atoms to form distorted face-sharing NaN₄O₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.73 Å. There is one shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond length. Pt is bonded in an octahedral geometry to four C and two Br atoms. All Pt-C bond lengths are 2.02 Å. There is one shorter (2.52 Å) and one longer (2.53 Å) Pt-Br bond length. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Pt and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.17 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Pt and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.17 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. There are two inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Pt atom. In the second Br site, Br is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Pt atom.
